what: Independent reference values for validation/calcium_store/reference_spec; see README.md beside this file. Every number is a double rounded once from the working precision.

units.the rule: a key's ending is its unit: _fmol, _V, _pJ, _s, _A, _per_s (1/s), _fmol_per_s, _pJ_per_s, _V_per_s, _fmol_per_s_per_V; it holds for everything inside that key
units.no unit: x and x_fuel (a free energy over RT), S, m, h, condition_factors, release_opening, in_domain
units.cycles and extents: one fmol of cycles, or of a reaction's extent, is 1 fmol
units.signs: a constant-field transfer is positive from the cell (inside) to the outside or the store; the release is positive from the store into the cell; pump and exchanger cycles and reaction extents are positive forward; J and the moves of a symport are positive for one inward cycle, from P to N; a heat is positive when it leaves the matter; a work is positive when the fuel supplies it
units.eigenvalues_per_s: five [real, imaginary] pairs by falling modulus; two are exactly zero (total Ca, total Na)
units.jacobian_per_s: row i, column j: d(rate of change of row i)/d(amount of row j), in the order of `rows`
units.*_change*: the value less its value at t = 0, a double of its own: a double of a large amount does not hold it
